#!/bin/bash
# What is read of the passes of the diagnostic once they are over: the table
# of every size, the profiles of the trace (where the goroutines block on
# sync, wait for a core, and sit in system calls), the CPU profiles by line,
# and the census of the sample from outside. Untimed; it builds the tools of
# Go it needs, so it runs after the chain, never next to it.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
X=$S/diag
for size in 100k 10m; do
  R=$X/runs/$size
  [ -d $R ] || continue
  python3 -I -B $X/summary.py $R tsv > $X/summary-$size.tsv
  python3 -I -B $X/summary.py $R > $X/summary-$size.txt
  T=$R/trace-c8
  if [ -s $T/trace.out ]; then
    for kind in sync sched syscall; do
      go tool trace -pprof=$kind $T/trace.out > $T/$kind.pprof 2> $T/$kind.err
      go tool pprof -top -nodecount=50 $T/$kind.pprof > $T/$kind-top.txt 2>> $T/$kind.err
      go tool pprof -top -cum -nodecount=80 $T/$kind.pprof > $T/$kind-cum.txt 2>> $T/$kind.err
      go tool pprof -traces $T/$kind.pprof > $T/$kind-traces.txt 2>> $T/$kind.err
    done
  fi
  for c in 1 8; do
    Q=$R/profile-c$c
    if [ -s $Q/cpu.prof ]; then
      go tool pprof -top -nodecount=60 $X/diag.test $Q/cpu.prof > $Q/cpu-top.txt 2> $Q/cpu.err
      go tool pprof -top -cum -nodecount=100 $X/diag.test $Q/cpu.prof > $Q/cpu-cum.txt 2>> $Q/cpu.err
      go tool pprof -lines -top -nodecount=100 $X/diag.test $Q/cpu.prof > $Q/cpu-lines.txt 2>> $Q/cpu.err
    fi
  done
  if [ -s $R/sample-c8/sample.txt ]; then
    python3 -I -B $S/grow10m/mon/census.py $R/sample-c8/sample.txt > $R/sample-c8/census.txt
    python3 -I -B $S/grow10m/mon/census.py -functions $R/sample-c8/sample.txt > $R/sample-c8/census-functions.txt
  fi
done
[ -s $X/summary-100k.tsv ] && [ -s $X/summary-10m.tsv ] && python3 -I -B $X/table.py $X/summary-100k.tsv $X/summary-10m.tsv > $X/table.md
date "+== %H:%M:%S post done"
